name: Automatic support ZIPs
detail: One-click runtime/log capture, opt-in schedule or Test Lab failure capture, size limits, manifest checksums, retention and authenticated downloads. Credentials and profiles excluded.
next: Enable in Diagnostics; review before sharing. Full world backups still require stopping the cluster.

name: Single-machine orchestration
detail: Manager, reusable worker IDs/ports, template installation, launch and supervision.
next: Validate launchers on Windows with JDK 21.

name: Manual worker controls
detail: Start, warm start, drain, cancel, maintenance, stop, restart, kill, retirement and deletion.
next: Deletion keeps existing explicit safeguards; use test worlds.

name: Pinned capacity
detail: Persistent worker pin prevents automatic scale-down while leaving manual controls available.
next: Use worker drawer → Pin online.

name: Named worker profiles
detail: Default heap/JVM profile and memory reservation are configurable.
next: Multiple named templates, affinity, priority and NUMA placement remain planned.

name: Manual / assisted / automatic scaling
detail: Sustain windows, cooldowns, RAM budgets, consolidation and operator approval.
next: Production scaling still depends on live migration acceptance.

name: Warm spares
detail: Warm worker creation and configurable warm capacity targets.
next: Predictive demand forecasting is planned.

name: Cluster performance history
detail: Bounded 5-second, minute and hourly tiers; graph ranges through seven days.
next: History accumulates in memory and resets on Manager restart.

name: Per-worker history
detail: One hour of bounded MSPT, percentile, heap, CPU, players and chunk telemetry.
next: Open a worker → Metrics. GC pause histograms and allocation rates need additional instrumentation.

name: Local host health
detail: Host CPU, available RAM, swap, storage, Manager heap and runtime.
next: Unavailable OS counters remain explicitly unavailable.

name: Extended platform counters
detail: Per-core CPU, network rate, disk latency, temperatures and file descriptors.
next: Add platform adapters without blocking Minecraft ticks.

name: Alerts and acknowledgements
detail: Live incidents, severity thresholds, persisted acknowledgements and resolved-incident clearing.
next: External notification channels are not connected.

name: Unified console / logs / audit
detail: Manager/worker consoles, search, pause, downloads, CSV export and audited admin mutations.
next: Long-term structured log retention/export pipelines remain planned.

name: Diagnostic summaries
detail: Download an allowlisted ZIP of component health, host measurements and transfer metadata.
next: Raw logs, secrets, world files and player profiles are excluded.

name: Consistent offline backups
detail: Stopped-cluster backup tool, SHA-256 manifest and archive verification.
next: Stop the Manager before taking a backup; live snapshots are not implemented.

name: Transactional program updater
detail: Portable folder selection, stopped-process checks, checksummed payload, backups and rollback.
next: Requires Windows execution acceptance on the target machine.

name: WebUI mockup layout
detail: Dark dashboard, six overview metrics, load graph, distribution, worker table, quick actions and events.
next: Live ownership map replaces fictional terrain imagery.

name: Operator quality of life
detail: Ctrl+K search, deep links, sort/export, dirty-form protection, responsive layout, focus trapping and stale-data indicators.
next: Use Feature Status to inspect every roadmap area.

name: World ownership map
detail: Coordinate-based region view, dimension filter, zoom, pan and cell inspection.
next: A terrain tile renderer is not yet connected.

name: Population layer planner
detail: Layer cells, lease placement, party affinity and split/merge foundations exist.
next: Validate large populations and game entity visibility.

name: Persistent bases across layers
detail: Blocks and BlockEntities use one-writer authority and journals.
next: Persistent entities, machines, mod semantics and complete replica tick suppression require further work.

name: Region authority / epochs
detail: Leases, fencing, recovery, transfer and authority map are implemented.
next: Prove no duplicate writers under real crash and load tests.

name: Region snapshot transfers
detail: Checksummed snapshot/install coordinator exists in the reference module.
next: Integrate and acceptance-test full region files across live workers.

name: BlockEntity persistence
detail: R9 flushes host blocks and current BlockEntity payloads before planned ownership changes. A fresh chest with 17 diamonds passed an immediate transfer between real NeoForge workers.
next: TFC machines, mod-specific state and long-running churn still need acceptance.

name: Data plane / replicas
detail: Chunk/block relay, fencing and deduplication exist.
next: Test stale publisher behavior, saturation and replica consistency.

name: Player state / profile restore
detail: Capture, preload, final snapshot and profile preparation are implemented.
next: Resolve the Windows advancement/profile sharing violation and validate inventory, attachments and profile capture under repeated transfers.

name: Physical backend migration
detail: Explicit transfers require destination readiness and real backend movement.
next: Run both directions with a connected client; confirm anchor and simulation.

name: Migration headroom
detail: Reject stale, full, unhealthy, high-MSPT and over-heap destinations.
next: Reserve host memory in Scaling and tune placement.maxHeapPercent.

name: Seamless NeoForge switching
detail: R19 captures completed client login replies and replays only verified matching destination tasks; unknown or changed configuration aborts explicitly.
next: Real joined-client A→B→A acceptance is still required; normal physical reconfiguration remains the default.

name: Transfer evidence timeline
detail: Correlated gateway switch stages, elapsed time, commit/abort diagnostics and exports.
next: Packet-level bridge logs remain gateway-side; client seamlessness requires observation.

name: Graceful evacuation / rolling restart
detail: Migration-aware stop waits for players and authority before exit.
next: Validate successful migration, timeout abort and last-worker handling.

name: Emergency crash recovery
detail: Backend failure checks, quarantine, profile preparation and redirects.
next: Validate hard crash behavior and repeat failure limits in live cluster.

name: Intentional shutdown
detail: Global gate suppresses failover, automatic planning and new topology mutations before workers stop.
next: Run a joined-client shutdown test to verify the proxy path.

name: Java toolchain isolation
detail: JDK 21 discovery for builds; isolated Java 25 gateway runtime retained.
next: Clean-machine Windows provisioning still requires acceptance.

name: Administrator security
detail: Argon2id login, encrypted vault, authenticated APIs, same-origin mutation checks and audit.
next: Default binding remains loopback; remote TLS belongs at the reverse proxy.

name: Granular administrative roles
detail: Current runtime has one administrator role.
next: Add Viewer, Operator, Administrator, Forensics and Owner enforcement server-side.

name: Economy / Framework boundary
detail: Economy remains separate from worker orchestration.
next: No Economy health or ledger provider is included in this source package.

name: Native desktop client
detail: New standard-library Tkinter client supplies authenticated worker controls, live summary and logs without PySide dependencies.
next: Desktop window behavior needs Windows acceptance; full Test Lab and topology administration use the WebUI.

name: Remote worker hosts
detail: Existing orchestration currently owns local processes.
next: Build authenticated remote node agent, resource inventory and host drain.

name: Shared SQL / messaging providers
detail: Local authoritative state stores are preserved.
next: Add transactional metadata provider, coordination and storage abstraction.

name: Cross-host world transfer
detail: Reference snapshot structures establish the transfer model.
next: Add authenticated install endpoints, fencing and interrupted-transfer recovery.

name: High availability
detail: Manager and gateway are currently single instances.
next: Add durable leadership, redundant gateways and replicated control-plane state.

name: Seamless cell boundaries
detail: Logical simulation movement exists separately from explicit physical migration.
next: Validate physical handover, visibility, persistent entities and no lost writes.

name: Test Lab
detail: Safe and live suites, handoff, inventory, chest and lifecycle checks are preserved.
next: Local tests cannot certify joined-client protocol or real Minecraft rendering.

name: Shared overworld time and weather
detail: One leased clock/weather owner, follower acknowledgements and persisted checkpoints. Verified with two headless NeoForge workers, owner loss and Manager restart.
next: Observe live client transitions; add TFC calendar/climate adapters and cluster-wide sleep voting.

name: Terrain mutation journaling
detail: R9 captures authoritative chunk block changes, including creeper damage. A real blast survived source hard-kill after Manager save acknowledgement.
next: Non-authoritative replica mutations and mods bypassing chunk mutation hooks need further coverage; unacknowledged writes can still be lost.

name: Confirmed saves before ownership transfer
detail: The source seals its region, flushes terrain and BlockEntities, and confirms durability before ownership changes. Worker-instance and epoch checks reject stale acknowledgements.
next: Failed or timed-out saves keep source ownership; inspect Save Health and cancel a pending save if needed.

name: Save health and transfer recovery
detail: Diagnostics shows fresh pending/failed writes and last durable save, support-summary export and normal-transfer recovery. Test Lab checks save health.
next: The normal-transfer setting takes effect after a full cluster restart. Failed persistence queues require inspection.

name: Guarded client handshake replay
detail: Bounded per-client in-memory transcripts, verified NeoForge network map equivalence, explicit mismatch reasons and a cooldown for repeated failed destinations.
next: Custom tasks, large transcripts and different registry/config bytes reject conservatively; client-visible seamlessness remains unproven.
